frozen_note: written on 2026-10-21; no live price had been captured and the capture is blocked in code until 2026-11-01
question: On sealed, prospective forecasts, does the live v1.3 winner probability add information beyond the Pinnacle no-vig price taken at the moment of sealing? It never produces a bet, stake or pick.
why_prospective: the retrospective comparison (nba_vs_market_protocol.json) uses seasons already inspected; here the forecast is sealed with a hash before tipoff and the price is captured by a separate step that cannot influence it
units: winner forecasts of cohorts sealed by nba.multimarket_v13_live, one per game, never re-forecast

capture.source: The Odds API current odds, sport basketball_nba, bookmakers=pinnacle, markets=h2h, decimal odds; one request returns every listed game; expected cost 1 credit
capture.seal_phase: taken right after the cohort is sealed; accepted only if received_at - sealed_at is between 0 and 15 minutes. A later capture is refused before spending a credit, so the price and the forecast describe the same moment
capture.close_phase: optional second capture before the first tipoff of the cohort (about 1 more credit); gives a price near the close for the CLV description only
capture.write_once: each phase is stored once per cohort with the raw response, its sha256, the reception time and the credits reported; a failed request is logged and never retried automatically; the stored price is never replaced
capture.independence: the capture step only reads the sealed bundle; the forecast code does not import it; no price enters the model
capture.team_names: the provider's 'Los Angeles Clippers' is read as 'LA Clippers'; an event must carry the same two names and a start time within 10 minutes of the sealed tipoff
capture.price_rules: event not started at reception; book update not after reception nor more than 30 minutes before it; both decimal prices finite and > 1
capture.devig: proportional primary; power method as sensitivity

inclusion: a winner forecast counts if it has a valid seal-phase price and an official final result (receipt verified by LiveCohort)
coverage_rule: valid-price games / sealed games >= 0.85, otherwise the evaluation is inconclusive

metrics.same_as_retrospective: Brier and log loss of model, market and equal logit blend; paired Brier difference and information weight c (logit p = logit(market) + c*(logit(model) - logit(market))) with 95% intervals that resample whole cohort dates (400 replicates, seed 20261101)
metrics.clv_description: for games with both phases: edge = model - open price, move = close price - open price; share of games with |edge| > 0.02 where edge and move have the same sign, and the slope of move on edge with the same date bootstrap. Description only, not part of the decision

decision_rule.when: once when the valid evaluated games reach 400, and once more at the end of the 2026-27 regular season; the final one supersedes. Looks in between are interim and carry no verdict
decision_rule.better_than_market: upper 95% bound of (model Brier - market Brier) < 0
decision_rule.otherwise: no evidence that the NBA winner probability adds information over Pinnacle; it is not used as a pick. A valid, expected result
decision_rule.scope: necessary, not sufficient, for any commercial use
